source.notes: Base A=127.5 mm and B=85.3 mm; G top opening=16.3 mm, H bottom=15.5 mm, K pitch=19.6 mm, C base height=18.8 mm, J depth=15.7 mm from supplied PSS rev0508. A1 datums are not specified; centered 4x6 grid is an explicit assumption: x=(127.5-5*19.6)/2=14.75, y=(85.3-3*19.6)/2=13.25. The number-of-wells table says 8, inconsistent with its 24-well title, 4x6 top view, and official 142485 product description. Use 24, preserve the discrepancy in documentation. Never scale the NOT TO SCALE drawing for unspecified datums. Outline/chamfers simplified. See docs/nunc-6-24.md.
